2607.24223.title: A New Role for Relevance: Guiding Corpus Interaction in Agentic Search
2607.24223.paper_summary: Relevance is a query-dependent estimate of whether a document or excerpt contains useful evidence. Existing retrieval agents use relevance to select top-$k$ content, but document relevance alone cannot localize, compose, or verify the evidence required by complex questions. Direct Corpus Interaction (DCI) enables such fine-grained operations through grep-style exploration, but its relevance-agnostic search can expose useful clues late and delay convergence. Recent advances use relevance to narrow the corpus into a working space for interaction. Once interaction begins, however, relevance still does not directly guide which documents grep searches first or distinguish informative excerpts from a broad set of matches to let LLMs see them first. We introduce the Relevance-Aware RipGrep Search Agent (RARG), which turns relevance into an execution prior for corpus interaction. RARG provides coarse-to-fine relevance guidance: it orders documents for sequential 'ripgrep' traversal to expose globally relevant clues earlier, initializes promising entry points with query-relevant paragraphs, and reranks grep matches to surface informative excerpts that document-level ranking may otherwise obscure. Across challenging browse question answering and reasoning-intensive retrieval, RARG improves the accuracy--efficiency frontier over retrieval-based and direct-interaction agents. These results demonstrate that relevance-aware interaction enables faster and more reliable search convergence.
2607.24223.paper_summary_zh: 相關性是依賴查詢的估計，用於判斷文檔或摘錄是否包含有用的證據。現有的檢索代理使用相關性來選擇前 $k$ 個內容，但僅僅依賴文檔的相關性無法定位、組合或驗證複雜問題所需的證據。直接語料庫互動（DCI）通過 grep 風格的探索實現了這種細緻的操作，但其與相關性無關的搜索可能會晚些揭示有用的線索，並延遲收斂。最近的進展利用相關性將語料庫縮小到交互的工作空間。然而，一旦開始互動，相關性仍然無法直接指導 grep 首先搜索哪些文檔或從廣泛的匹配集中區分出有信息的摘錄，讓 LLMs 首先看到它們。我們介紹了相關性感知的 RipGrep 搜索代理（RARG），它將相關性轉化為語料庫互動的執行先驗。RARG 提供了粗到細的相關性指導：它為順序的 'ripgrep' 遍歷排序文檔，以更早地揭示全球相關的線索，使用與查詢相關的段落初始化有前景的切入點，並重新排名 grep 匹配，以顯示文檔級排名可能掩蓋的信息摘錄。在具有挑戰性的瀏覽問題回答和推理密集的檢索中，RARG 改善了基於檢索和直接互動代理的準確性-效率邊界。這些結果證明，相關性感知的互動使搜索收斂更快且更可靠。
